core_obligations: Record the inclusion f(X_ft-pts) contained in Y_ft-pts by the companion lemma (proof lines 5115-5116).
Represent a finite type point y of Y by a locally finite type morphism Spec(k) -> Y (proof lines 5117-5118).
Use surjectivity to make X_k nonempty and choose a finite type point x of X_k (proof lines 5119-5122).
Show that X_k -> X is locally of finite type, so the image of x in X is a finite type point mapping to y (proof lines 5123-5128).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally of finite type and surjective morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the finite type points of X map onto the finite type points of Y (source lines 5106-5112). One inclusion is the companion lemma on finite type points under locally finite type morphisms. For the other, a finite type point y is represented by a locally finite type Spec(k) -> Y; surjectivity makes X_k = Spec(k) x_Y X nonempty, so it has a finite type point x, and since X_k -> X is locally of finite type as a base change, the image of x in X is a finite type point mapping to y.
